name: ha-signature
description: Site et API de H&A Signature — promotion immobilière à Annaba (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.preview: prisma generate && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: prisma generate && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.typecheck: prisma generate && wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv --strict-vars=false cloudflare-env.d.ts && tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute ha-signature --local --file .seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute ha-signature --remote --file .seed.sql
